title: ashwingopalsamy/us-fed-funds-rate-dataset / annual
description: Yearly summaries computed from `rates` and `decisions`: the rate at each end of the year, its range, the net and gross change, and how many hikes, cuts and holds there were.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

start_rate_pct.description: The rate in force on 1 January (the latest change effective before it). Null when the series starts later in the year.

end_rate_pct.description: The rate in force on 31 December, or on the last observed date for the current year.

min_rate_pct.description: Lowest rate in force during the year.

max_rate_pct.description: Highest rate in force during the year.

net_change_bps.description: End minus start, in basis points. Null when the start is unknown.

gross_hikes_bps.description: Sum of hikes in the year, in basis points.

gross_cuts_bps.description: Sum of cuts in the year, in basis points (a positive number).

hold_count.description: Number of announced holds. Null where the decision ledger does not cover the whole year.

decision_count.description: Number of announced decisions. Null where the decision ledger does not cover the whole year.

is_partial_year.description: True for a year the data does not fully cover: the first year of the series or the current year.

record_text.description: One deterministic sentence summarising the year, for search and retrieval. Generated from the fields, not written by a model.
